inherited_handoff.obligation_overlay: The Phase 8 rows are immutable inherited obligations, not current pass claims. The BH-03 roadmap and runtime-loss pending-review rows are resolved for internal development by this source-bound acceptance. Budget, platform support, upgrades, release controls, and repeat duties retain their owners and due points.

finding_overlay.BX-BH03-FINDING-UNREPORTED-RUNTIME-LOSS: closed by registry-owned handle observation, race tests, and active browser callback fault injection
finding_overlay.BX-BH03-FINDING-MEMORY-EVIDENCE-BOUNDED: retained limitation: not long-lived-page leak proof; performance-owner, BH-22
finding_overlay.BX-BH03-FINDING-HISTORICAL-RUNNER-PROVEN: current evidence rebound to complete committed candidate and harness hash; historical raw record remains unchanged

review_lenses.architecture: Runtime-ready handle loss observation and registry ownership stay in reusable JavaScript. Profile records transitions; no component, DOM protocol, or server authority added.
review_lenses.implementation: Latched loss before subscription rejects activation; active loss synchronously leaves ready; token-bound observers exclude obsolete handles, replacement loss rejects replay, and intentional stop clears observers.
review_lenses.conformance: Eight new real-startup/registry injected-frame tests plus five active scenarios per browser; repeated Phase 6 conformance and Phase 7 measurements passed. Controlled failure callbacks are not OS crashes.
review_lenses.accessibility: No semantic or focus contract change. Existing BH-02 evidence remains inherited; manual AT and native role gaps remain unclosed.
review_lenses.security: Existing acquisition, compatibility and correlated generation checks retained. Test-only browser instrumentation is route-injected, never shipped in profile assets. Production security/release review remains due.
review_lenses.packaging: No dependency or toolkit change. AtomVM-in-Wasm executes the pinned AVM bundle; all original artifact checks and pinned Mix/runtime tests repeated.
review_lenses.provenance: Each retained run names full Section 9.3 revision. Current runtime sources are checked against that git tree and SHA-256. Historical exception helper is restricted to exact authorized paths and a hash-bound authorization.

inherited_handoff.independence: Single implementing agent using seven analytical lenses; not independent external review.
limitations: Controlled runtime onExit/onAbort callback injection exercises real frame/startup/registry and AVM root replay, not OS-level crashes, worker hangs or device memory pressure.
Five fresh contexts and coarse Chrome memory observations do not prove absence of long-lived-page leaks; Firefox governed heap API remains unavailable.

All inherited native/API/release obligations remain in force. Internal acceptance grants neither browser support nor public API stability nor BH-04 implementation authority.
